title: stephanomeria virgata var. tomentosa
intro: Stephanomeria virgata var. tomentosa, commonly known as Woolly Wirelettuce, is a variety of the Stephanomeria virgata plant, which is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health issues. Woolly Wirelettuce has been reported to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe and heal wounds, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Woolly Wirelettuce include saponins, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antispasmodic, anti-allergic, and antioxidant effects.
